URL: https://www.euronews.com/2026/07/22/trump-says-us-has-no-interest-in-iran-talks-as-cost-of-war-increases
Euronews, 22 Jul 2026 05:45 CET — Trump (Oval Office): "They want to desperately meet. And until they're ready to meet in a meaningful way, we have no interest in meeting." Brent rose to $92/barrel Wednesday. Hegseth told Senate war cost $37.5bn (from ~$29bn mid-May); defended $67bn supplemental funding request as "urgent" and "necessary." Pakistan PM Shehbaz Sharif expressed "deep concern," urged "all sides to exercise restraint." Sharif held talks with Iran Interior Minister Eskander Momeni; Momeni also met army chief Asim Munir (broker of interim deal).
